blocks.tamil_translation: placed any hardship upon you; (hold on to) the religion of your father Ibrahim; He (Allah) named you “Muslims' before - and in this (Qur'an) too (the same name); (this is so that) the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over (the rest of) mankind.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- On the Day of Qiyamah, when the earlier communities deny, saying that no Prophet came to them, the other Prophets will bring forward the community of the Prophet ﷺ as witnesses for themselves. The community of the Prophet ﷺ will testify that the earlier Prophets certainly conveyed the commands of Allah to their respective communities. The community of the Prophet ﷺ will be questioned, “How do you know that they conveyed it?”, and they will reply, “The Prophet ﷺ told us”. And the Prophet ﷺ will confirm it, saying, “The testimony of this Ummah is correct!'. Some commentators have explained this ayah as: We chose you so that Rasulullah ﷺ would teach you the Deen, and you would teach that Deen to others.
(Kashf-ur-Rahman)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُبَلِّغٌ وَاللهُ يَهْدِي، وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ وَاللهُ يُعْطِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير وهو حديث حسن، الجامع الصغير:٣٩٥/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Surely I am only one who conveys the Deen to the people; it is Allah who gives guidance. And surely I am only one who distributes knowledge and wisdom; it is Allah who gives understanding - that Rasulullah ﷺ said this, Hazrat Mu'awiyah (RA)
